subject: executor: fix hang in hash agg when exceeding memory limit leads to panic (#57641)
summary: Reviewed the single-file change in `pkg/executor/aggregate/agg_hash_partial_worker.go` relative to its parent. The commit refactors `HashAggPartialWorker.getChildInput` to only receive from channels and moves chunk swapping / give-back (and mem tracking) into `fetchChunkAndProcess` after `defer w.inflightChunkSync.Done()`, preventing a panic during memory-limit handling / failpoints from stranding `inflightChunkSync` and hanging `HashAggExec.fetchChildData` (which waits on `inflightChunkSync.Wait()` in both spill and shutdown paths). Checked minimal related synchronization logic in `pkg/executor/aggregate/agg_hash_executor.go` and later history up to `upstream/master`; later commits keep the same hang-fix structure (with unrelated follow-ups like memory-tracker statistic adjustment and spill-file cleanup). No remaining Blocker/High executor correctness/concurrency issues found.
